title: Unscoped file-selection glob silently ignores a requested sub-range when the directory holds extra files

source.evidence_note: Self-collected from the same conversation in which the incident occurred. See .local/incidents/unscoped-train-files-glob.md for full evidence; no separate export file exists. Exact origination turn of the original defect is in a pre-summary (compacted) portion of the conversation and is unavailable as raw transcript.

horizon.earlier_event: run_rollout_sft.sh authored with data.train_files as an unscoped wildcard glob, and a header comment claiming START_STEP/END_STEP govern replay scope (they do not)
horizon.later_decision: Multiple later sub-range SFT jobs launched using START_STEP/END_STEP alone, trusting the unverified earlier claim
horizon.intervening_work: Many unrelated tasks across the same long conversation: disk-usage management, HuggingFace uploads, an unrelated SFT loss-objective feature, full-range (non-sub-range) training runs that incidentally populated the shared dataset directory with the full 1040-shard dataset
horizon.mechanism: Hydra CLI override data.train_files took an unscoped shell glob over a shared, growing directory; START_STEP/END_STEP were wired only into a separate download-range helper, never into this override

failure.expected_behavior: select_train_files(dataset_dir, start_step, end_step) returns exactly the shard files in [start_step, end_step], even when dataset_dir holds additional files outside that range
failure.observed_behavior: An unscoped glob() over dataset_dir returns every shard file present, regardless of start_step/end_step, which are accepted as parameters but never used to restrict the glob
failure.target_predicate: len(returned_files) == n_shards_in_directory (i.e. the full directory listing) instead of == (end_step - start_step + 1)

commands.setup: No setup needed beyond a Python 3.9+ interpreter; checks/judge.py creates its own disposable temp directory per run.
commands.run_agent: Not implemented in this pass -- no fresh-model-attempt condition was run. See task/README.md for the task as it would be presented.

commands.control: python3 checks/judge.py --solution reference/faulty_solution.py  # expect overall=FAIL, exit 1, main case status=target_failure

comparison_note: No fresh-model comparison run in this pass (deferred; see incident-evidence.md Limitations).
